mapper.select: select count(*) as total_records, COALESCE(SUM(time_spent_hrs), 0) as total_hours, COALESCE(AVG(task_weight), 0) as avg_task_weight, COALESCE(AVG(quality_score), 0) as avg_quality_score, COALESCE(SUM(time_spent_hrs * task_weight * quality_score), 0) as eci_score, CAST(GROUP_CONCAT(quality_score ORDER BY work_date ASC) AS CHAR) as quality_scores_str, CAST(GROUP_CONCAT(task_weight ORDER BY work_date ASC) AS CHAR) as task_weight_history_str, CAST(GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(work_date, ':', COALESCE(time_spent_hrs * task_weight * quality_score, 0)) ORDER BY work_date ASC) AS CHAR) as eci_history_str, CAST(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT tp.required_skills SEPARATOR ',') AS CHAR) as inferred_skill_tags from biz_workload_detail wd left join biz_task_project tp on wd.project_id = tp.id where wd.staff_id = #{staffId}

SELECT t1.staff_name, t1.task_desc, CONCAT(t1.staff_name, ' - ', t1.task_desc) as task_name, t1.start_date, t1.end_date, t1.hours, t1.task_count FROM ( SELECT s.sname as staff_name, w.task_desc as task_desc, DATE_FORMAT(MIN(w.start_date), '%Y-%m-%d') as start_date, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(w.end_date), '%Y-%m-%d') as end_date, SUM(w.time_spent_hrs) as hours, COUNT(w.id) as task_count, w.staff_id FROM biz_workload_detail w LEFT JOIN hr_employee s ON w.staff_id = s.id WHERE w.project_id = #{projectId} GROUP BY w.staff_id, s.sname, w.task_desc ) t1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT staff_id, MAX(total_hours) as max_hours FROM ( SELECT staff_id, task_desc, SUM(time_spent_hrs) as total_hours FROM biz_workload_detail WHERE project_id = #{projectId} GROUP BY staff_id, task_desc ) t2 GROUP BY staff_id ) t3 ON t1.staff_id = t3.staff_id AND t1.hours = t3.max_hours ORDER BY t1.staff_name ASC

SELECT w.staff_id as staffId, s.sname as staffName, p.pname as position, SUM(w.time_spent_hrs) as hours, SUM(w.time_spent_hrs * w.task_weight * w.quality_score) as eci FROM biz_workload_detail w LEFT JOIN hr_employee s ON w.staff_id = s.id LEFT JOIN sys_post p ON s.post_id = p.id WHERE w.project_id = #{projectId} GROUP BY w.staff_id, s.sname, p.pname ORDER BY eci DESC
SELECT * FROM biz_workload_detail ORDER BY work_date DESC, created_time DESC
SELECT DISTINCT w.staff_id FROM biz_workload_detail w WHERE w.staff_id NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT staff_id FROM hr_emp_image WHERE status = 1 ) ORDER BY w.staff_id
